readerNotes.line: Line enters at the north near Roermond, runs down past Aachen to Monschau, west along the north shoulder of the bulge to its tip east of Dinant, back east along the south shoulder with the Bastogne salient poking north around 5.66 to 5.77E, then east to Echternach, south along the Moselle and Saar, leaving the east edge near 49.25N. The unticked line running south from St Avold is a boundary, not the front. Points near the Bastogne salient and the double hatched Westwall band near Monschau are approximate to about 0.02 degrees.
